title: N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) CRIME IN INDIA - 1996 18.2.2 During 1996, of the 36624 complaints received (from 24 States and 5 UTs) at All-India level, in as much as 15,137 cases inquiries were constituted. Thus, in more than 40 per cent cases of complaints suitable inquiry was instituted. Of these, in 319 cases, judicial inquiry was ordered. In 291 cases magisterial inquiry was conducted; in 14,527 cases regular departmental inquiry was initiated. The total number of cases that were either not substantiated or not found true amounted to 28,347 cases, which amount to 77.4 per cent of the reported complaints. Detailed States/UTs-wise break-up of this information is presented in the Table-95.
